name: Pildash
title: Son of Nahor
summary: Pildash was one of the eight sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, by his wife Milcah. He is mentioned in the genealogy in Genesis 22 as part of Abraham's extended family. Although he plays a minor role in the Bible, he is part of the patriarchal lineage that connects Abraham's family with the peoples of Mesopotamia.

keyEvents.title: The News About Nahor's Sons
keyEvents.description: After Abraham demonstrated his faithfulness by being willing to sacrifice Isaac, he received news that his brother Nahor had fathered eight sons with his wife Milcah, including Peleg.

keyEvents.title: Part of Abraham's Extended Family
keyEvents.description: Peleg was part of the broader family structure of Abraham, linking the patriarchs' lineage to the ethnic groups in the ancient Middle East.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy as Context for Rebekah's Origins
keyEvents.description: The list of Nahor's sons, including Peleg, provides the genealogical background for Rebekah, who was Nahor's granddaughter through Bethuel and later became Isaac's wife.

keyEvents.title: The Connection Between Mesopotamia and Canaan
keyEvents.description: Through the genealogy mentioning Peleg, the Bible shows the enduring connection between Abraham's family in Canaan and his relatives who remained in Mesopotamia.
